<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Leviticus 5:21">Targ. Y. Lev. V, 21</cite>, sq.; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Bava Kamma 107a:2">B. Kam. 107ᵃ</cite> <he>בכוליה בעי דנִכְפְּרֵיה</he> ed. (Ms. M. <he>דנכפר ליה</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l.) he would have liked to deny the whole of his indebtedness, <he>והאי דלא כָפְרֵיה</he> and the reason why he did not do so.
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 105b:1">Ib. 105ᵇ</cite> <he>ממונא קא כ׳ ליה</he> through his denial he withholds from him value.

<cite ref="Moed Katan 18b:14">M. Kat. 18ᵇ</cite> <he>כַּפְרַת בה</he> Ms. M. thou growest a disbeliever through it (when thy prayer is not answered; ed. <he>כ׳ בה׳</he> thou renouncest the Lord); a. fr.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 30:20">Targ. Prov. XXX, 20</cite>.—
<cite ref="Bava Batra 167a">B. Bath. 167ᵃ</cite> <he>כ׳ ליה וכ׳</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>מחקיה</he>) he erased the horizontal lines of the Beth (v. <cite ref="K00656"><he>כַּכָּא</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Chullin 8b:6">Ḥull. 8ᵇ</cite> <he>למִיכַפְּרֵיה</he> with which to wipe the knife off.
<cite ref="Yevamot 115b:7">Yeb. 115ᵇ</cite> <he>מיכַפַּר הוה כַפֵּר</he> he would have obliterated the mark.
<cite ref="Gittin 56a">Gitt. 56ᵃ</cite> <he>ואתי לכַפּוּרֵי וכ׳</he> and wants to wipe his hands off on this man (me), i.e. desires to put the responsibility on me; a. e.
<cite ref="Onkelos Leviticus 16:17">Targ. Lev. XVI, 17</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Zevachim 6a:7">Zeb. 6ᵃ</cite> <he>מקיבעא לא מְכַפְּרָא וכ׳</he> as a specially appointed offering it has no atoning effect, by implication it has; a. fr.

senses.gloss: to be wiped out, obliterated. Targ. II Esth. III, 8.
to be forgiven, to be expiated. Ib.
units: <cite ref="Onkelos Deuteronomy 21:8">Targ. Deut. XXI, 8</cite>; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Yoma 50b:7">Yoma 50ᵇ</cite> <he>בקביעותא מִתְכַּפְּרֵי וכ׳</he> (Ms. M. 2 <cite ref="M01420"><he>מִיכַּ׳</he></cite>) do they (the high priest’s kindred and fellow priests) obtain forgiveness by special appointment (so as to be considered fellow owners of the sacrifice) or by implication? <cite ref="Keritot 24a:6">Kerith. 24ᵃ</cite> <he>מִיכַּפַּרְנָא באידך חבריה</he> my atonement shall be effected through the other animal; a. e.
